# Ticks

Progress/usage as ticks (Bencho "tick").

## Notes

Progress/usage as ticks (Bencho "tick"). Off ticks sit at 55% height in a 14% ink tint; on ticks rise to full height in ink (or vermilion via tone="needs" past a threshold).
